title: Floating dock repair and relocation
agency: STATE, DEPARTMENT OF.STATE, DEPARTMENT OF.US EMBASSY SAN SALVADOR
description_text: PR15973648 This is a request for quotation to repair and relocate one floating dock. Price should be quoted excluding IVA. SAM registration is required for award consideration. The solicitation package, which includes specifications and instructions on how to submit the quote, is attached. A mandatory site visit will be held on June 01 at 10.00am at Costa del Sol police base, San Luis La Herradura, La Paz, El Salvador, and should be confirmed no later than May 25, 2026. All questions and requests for additional information must be submitted in writting through email to CotoAB@state.gov
